title: amoora rohituka
intro: Amoora rohituka, commonly known as Indian ironwood, is a deciduous tree that belongs to the family Anacardiaceae. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, as well as its use as a natural remedy for skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Amoora rohituka include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Amoora rohituka include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
